title: Most Followed Person on TikTok: Top 10 List
summary: See who has the most TikTok followers, review a dated top-account snapshot, and learn why audience fit matters more than follower count alone.
body_markdown:
## Who has the most TikTok followers?


Khaby Lame leads the individual creator ranking. His recognizable, largely wordless comedy is understandable across many markets without each video needing translation. That does not explain every follow, but it shows how a clear, repeatable format can build recognition across languages.


Charli D'Amelio ranks second on the same date. MrBeast ranks third and has added followers since the July snapshot used by the original article. Those changes are a useful reminder that a fixed top ten should never be presented as permanent.


### People and organization accounts are different


TikTok's official account also appears near the top of the overall list, but it is not a person. The same applies to sports, media, and brand accounts. Khaby Lame is the short answer when the question asks for a person; a list of accounts needs clear account-type labels.


### Why the snapshot date matters


Creators gain and lose followers every day, and tracking services round very large totals. Use the figures below as a comparable snapshot, then open the source for the latest position. Do not base contracts, plans, or budgets on an old list without checking the live profiles.
